reuse.why: All providers share the new link checks, and Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, although unlink-state clearing remains copied.

duplication.why: Fintegra duplicates the existing linking workflow, transaction-download protocol and Akahu balance calculation, while replacement duplicates unlinkAccount's local field reset.

placement.why: Provider types, configuration, handlers and downloading follow existing layers, but an ensure-named validation helper now also mutates link ownership.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking rules, replacement option and server-side Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared checks make rule updates manageable, but another copied provider workflow and a validation helper with destructive side effects increase maintenance burden.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing bank-selection and sync abstractions are used; unlinkAccount includes provider-side cleanup, so it is not directly suitable for transferring a link.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount compresses the existing account creation/update and sync workflow, and downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing authenticated request and response-mapping logic without sharing it.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch that clears another account's link, changing a validation helper into a mutating operation; all six linking handlers still call it.
